learning_outcomes.text: Comprehend the definitions of anti-derivative and indefinite integral.
Calculate indefinite integrals using substitution and integration by parts methods.
Calculate indefinite integrals by performing various substitutions.
Know the concepts of Riemann sum and definite integral and interpret them geometrically. Calculate the definite integral of specially defined functions.
Calculate the area of the region under the curve and the volumes of solids of revolution using definite integrals.
Calculate the arc length of a curve and the surface areas of solids of revolution.
Recognize improper integrals. Interpret the properties of improper integrals.
Calculate areas and volumes using improper integrals.

syllabus_topics: Indefinite integral. Rules for indefinite integration. Method of substitution.
Integration by parts method. Integral of rational functions.
Concept of definite integral. Partition of an interval, Riemann sum and definite integral.
Calculation of definite integral using the definition. Proof of fundamental integration rules.
Fundamental theorems of integral calculus. Method of substitution in definite integral.
Integration by parts method in definite integral. Definite integral of some specially defined functions.
Arc length of a curve. Surface area of solids of revolution.
Area and volume calculation using improper integrals.
assessment_rules: The overall grade is calculated from 50% in-term success and 50% final exam. In-term success is composed of Quiz 1 (10%), Assignment 1 (10%), and Midterm 1 (80%).
